risks.title: Insufficient liquidity risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned first in the 10-K with strong language (material adverse effect). It concerns the company's ability to meet sudden liquidity shortfalls. The Capital category is highly weighted for a financial institution

risks.title: Interest rate risk exposure
risks.score_rationale: The risk is clearly identified in the dedicated section. The transition to floating SOFR for multiple preferred series demonstrates increased exposure. The language is technical but affirmative. The Macro category is systemic

risks.title: Significant off-balance sheet commitments
risks.score_rationale: Total off-balance sheet exposure of 1.4B USD, notably through unconsolidated funds and capital commitments. Mentioned as material in the 10-K. The Capital category is critical

risks.title: Dependence on equity issuance
risks.score_rationale: Active ATM program (750M USD) and frequent market recourse. Mention of mandatory distribution of 90% of taxable income, limiting capital retention. Repetitive and concerning language

risks.title: Residential loan credit risk
risks.score_rationale: Exposure of 9.3B USD in UPB of residential loans in off-balance sheet securitizations, with 600M USD loss risk. Explicit mention of credit risk exposure. Credit category is central to the business

risks.title: Physical financing risk on TBAs
risks.score_rationale: Mention of risk of having to take physical delivery of MBS if rollovers become costly. Impact on liquidity. Prudent but not alarmist language. Industrial category is less critical

risks.title: Clawback on incentive revenues
risks.score_rationale: Obligation to repay incentive revenues received if future losses occur in funds. Mentioned in off-balance sheet commitments. Real legal risk but limited to a portion of revenues

ai_positioning.summary: Rithm Capital does not mention artificial intelligence in its 10-K/20-F filing. There is no significant mention of AI in the provided text
